prompts.CONTINUE: Continue from where you stopped, and finish. {tail}
prompts.READ_ONLY: Not allowed: this chat turn is read-only. Continue without it and answer with what you have. {tail}
prompts.NO_QUESTIONS: No one can answer tool questions in this chat. Ask in your reply text instead. {tail}
prompts.MERGE_LANES: Merge the lane answers from run {run}. Drop the duplicates, rank every finding by how many lanes agree, and list the disagreements on their own. {tail}
prompts.COMPARE_LANES: Compare the lane answers from run {run}: one task, answered by different models. Say where they agree, check each disagreement against the code, and say which answer holds up. {tail}
prompts.RESUME_TASK: The {agent} subagent stopped before it finished ({description}). Call the task tool again with task_id {task} so it resumes where it was, let it finish, then report. {tail}
prompts.RERUN_TASK: The {agent} subagent stopped before it finished ({description}). Run it again, let it finish, then report. {tail}
prompts.LANES_GONE: Those lane answers are gone. They live only in this window, and it has been reloaded since, so nothing was run. Send the lanes again to merge them.

applyNow.label: Apply now
applyNow.prompt: You are the editing agent and edits are allowed. Apply the plan now.

step1.label: #1: {item}
step1.prompt: Do only #1: {item}. Then stop and report what changed.

fix1.label: Fix #1: {item}
fix1.prompt: Fix only #1: {item}. Then stop and report what changed.

fixAll.label: Fix all
fixAll.prompt: Fix all the issues you listed. Report what changed. {tail}

recommend.label: Your call
recommend.prompt: Go with your recommendation and proceed. {tail}

apply.label: Ship it
apply.prompt: Apply what you just proposed. Report what changed. {tail}

review1.label: Review {file}
review1.prompt: Review the change you just made to {file} for bugs and regressions. {tail}

reviewN.label: Review {n} files
reviewN.prompt: Review the changes you just made for bugs and regressions. {tail}

tests.label: Test it
tests.prompt: Run the tests relevant to what you changed and fix any failures.

fixTests.label: Fix failing tests
fixTests.prompt: Fix the failing tests you reported, then run them again. Report what changed. {tail}

deeper.label: Dig deeper · {effort}
deeper.prompt: Look at this again more carefully and settle what you were unsure about. Verify each claim against the code. {tail}
